title: The push rule and its guard text name `git push origin HEAD:<branch>`, which fails for a new branch from a detached worktree
why: Coordinator, 07:56 CST Nov 18: a designer agent's push `git push origin HEAD:<branch>` failed when it created a new branch from a detached worktree; it needed `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>`. An agent worktree is often detached, so Claude is likely to hit this again.
source: coordinator 07:56 CST Nov 18, relayed to triage 11
note: Not built; not read in the code. Next: find the push rule and guard text that print `HEAD:<branch>` (the agent push form: lint/test_agent_push_form.py is one place to look) and change them to `HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>`, test-author first (a push from a detached worktree to a new branch must pass). Mover: a lane after the coordinator's say-so.
